text: Proseware kickoff for the M365 tenant consolidation today. Valentina Rossi (IT Director) is our day-to-day contact, Arjun Mehta runs procurement. 3 tenants into 1, ~1,800 users, target is done by end of June.
Draft a kickoff recap email to Valentina: scope (3 tenants into 1, about 1,800 mailboxes), weekly checkpoint Thursdays at 10, and the open question on the legacy mail archive.
Lamna Healthcare: Nadia Rahman (Clinical Systems Manager) says the HL7 interface errors dropped from ~40 a day to 6 after the patch. She wants a monthly error report from now on.
Proseware: Arjun wants the rate card split by role for the network refresh quote, not one blended rate. He needs it by Fri 24 Apr for their budget round.

Southridge Video: their media archive storage bill jumped 30% in March, roughly $18k over forecast. Camille Laurent (Head of Media Ops) wants options for tiering cold footage. Prep me a short list of options with pros and cons I can talk through on Thursday.

Proseware security review with Sinead O'Brien (InfoSec). The legacy archive has 2 years of mail under legal hold and can't be migrated until their legal team signs off. Could be a 3-4 week delay on tenant 3.
Draft a short risk note to Valentina about the legal hold: what it blocks, the likely 3-4 week impact on tenant 3, and what we need from their legal team.
Vandelay Industries: Marisol Ortega (Supply Chain Director) wants EDI links to two new freight forwarders before peak season in September. Early days, no budget number yet.
Prep me for the 10am Proseware checkpoint: status per tenant, the legal hold risk, and what I need from Valentina this week.
Proseware: met Ken Adeyemi, their COO, at the exec sponsor lunch. Anything over $250k needs his signature. He's sharp on cost and asked for one slide on our service desk metrics each quarter.
Southridge: Camille liked the tiering options, wants a costed version of option 2 (cold tier after 90 days) by next Friday.

Proseware network refresh: survey of the Austin data centre done, 22 racks, cabling is a mess. Hiroshi Tanaka (network lead) wants the core switch swap done over a weekend in May. The Chicago sales office Wi-Fi is their top ticket generator, might add it to scope.
Umbrella: validation docs for the LIMS upgrade are 2 weeks behind. Dr. Petra Novak (QA Lead) needs the IQ/OQ scripts before the 11 May audit. This one's a real risk.
Draft an escalation email to Petra with a recovery plan: two extra validation engineers from Monday, daily stand-up, scripts ready by 5 May.
Draft the cover note for the Proseware network refresh quote to Arjun: role-based rate card attached, weekend cutover for the core switches, 6-week delivery from PO.
munsons pickles - tiny account but owner Dot Munson wants their file server moved to sharepoint, 35 users. quote this week if poss

Proseware monthly service review just now with Valentina, Ken and Arjun. Service desk numbers are good: 96.1% of P2s in SLA, CSAT 4.5, ticket volume down 8% since the self-service portal went live. Two P1s this month, both the VPN concentrator; RCA accepted and the firmware fix is booked for Sat 2 May. Valentina wants the monthly pack to show 6-month trend lines instead of a single month, and she wants the top 5 recurring issues slide back. Arjun raised invoices again: every line needs their PO number or AP rejects it, so finance has to fix the template before the next run. Tenant consolidation is on track apart from the archive hold, legal answer expected this week. They asked about extending service desk hours to 8pm for the west coast team, I said we'd price it. oh and Ken mentioned they're moving the head office to Denver this summer, so at some point we'll need to plan the desk-side and network work for that, he'll share details once the lease is signed. Last thing: Valentina is on leave 4 to 8 May and Arjun covers approvals while she's out. Next review 19 May, same slot.
Lamna: Nadia approved the format for the monthly HL7 error report. First one due 5 May.
Proseware: legal cleared the archive hold for tenant 3, so we're back on the end-of-June date. Sinead wants the retention policies documented before cutover.
Write me a one-paragraph summary of where Vandelay stands for our pipeline review: EDI scope, two forwarders, September peak, no budget yet, decision maker Marisol.
Proseware checkpoint: tenants 1 and 2 done, 1,140 users moved, 3 tickets open. Valentina's happy. Her ask: two training sessions on the new SharePoint structure in May.
Draft a short reply to Valentina proposing 12 and 14 May for the SharePoint training and asking for headcount per session.
Umbrella: Petra accepted the recovery plan, the 2 validation engineers start Monday.
Proseware: Arjun says the network quote goes to their CFO next week, he expects pushback on the weekend premium.
Is Proseware relocating anywhere?

expect.should: Says Proseware is moving its head office to Denver this summer (summer 2026).
expect.should_not: Says it has no information about a relocation, or names a different city (such as Austin or Chicago) as where Proseware is moving.
